title: The Ambassador
text: From 1958 the Hindustan Ambassador was the car of ministers, taxi drivers and big families alike. It stayed in production for more than fifty years.

title: “Madhumati”
text: In 1958 Bimal Roy’s “Madhumati”, with Dilip Kumar and Vyjayanthimala, was the biggest hit of the year. People still sing “Suhana Safar”.
